message.content: I wake up at six every morning, have some yoghurt for breakfast, and then I cycle to the bakery. It's a short ride, maybe ten minutes. I like the routine because it helps me feel grounded. Most days, things go smoothly. I get to work, label the bread trays, wrap the loaves, and clean the counter. I've been doing this for a while now. Sometimes, I hear a voice when I'm alone, but I try not to let it bother me too much. It's just something I've learned to live with.
